rater_1_rationale: Flags NetworkPolicies that do not select any pods, an unused resource rather than a security or availability issue (kube-linter v0.8.3).
rater_2_rationale: Flags NetworkPolicies whose podSelector matches no deployment, a stale cross-object reference (kube-linter v0.8.3 docs).

rater_1_rationale: Flags NetworkPolicy peer selectors that match no pods, flagging unused ingress/egress rules (kube-linter v0.8.3).
rater_2_rationale: Flags NetworkPolicy ingress/egress peer podSelectors that match no deployment, a broken reference (kube-linter v0.8.3 docs).

rater_1_rationale: Flags Services that do not match any pods, indicating an unused or misconfigured service (kube-linter v0.8.3).
rater_2_rationale: Flags Services whose selector matches no deployment, a broken reference between objects (kube-linter v0.8.3 docs).

rater_1_rationale: Flags ServiceMonitors that do not match any services, an unused monitoring configuration (kube-linter v0.8.3).
rater_2_rationale: Flags ServiceMonitors whose selectors match no Service, a stale reference (kube-linter v0.8.3 docs).

rater_1_rationale: Flags NodePort and LoadBalancer services, which expose pods on external interfaces (kube-linter v0.8.3).
rater_2_rationale: Flags Services of forbidden types such as NodePort or LoadBalancer, which exposes workloads outside the cluster (kube-linter v0.8.3 docs).

rater_1_rationale: Flags liveness probes to unexposed ports, a configuration inconsistency (kube-linter v0.8.3).
rater_2_rationale: Flags liveness probes pointing at a port the container does not expose, so the probe misbehaves at runtime (kube-linter v0.8.3 docs).

rater_1_rationale: Flags deployments without node affinity, missing node placement strategy (kube-linter v0.8.3).
rater_2_rationale: Flags deployments with no node affinity, an opinionated scheduling-placement policy outside the four categories (kube-linter v0.8.3 docs).
